text: Intractable means extremely hard to solve or manage, like something that resists every grip. Here it describes seven maths puzzles that have stumped experts for generations.

Opacity is the quality of not letting light through, and by extension, of being impossible to see into or understand. The AI gives answers without a clear explanation, so humans must do lots of checking.
Legible means clear enough to read, and figuratively, clear enough for people to understand. The worry is that machine-run science might stop making sense to human scientists.
A conundrum is a confusing, difficult problem or puzzle with no obvious answer. The seven prize questions are the most famous unsolved puzzles in maths.
Seven famous unsolved maths problems announced in 2000, each carrying a $1m reward from a research institute. Before this year only one had ever been solved.
Navier-Stokes is the name of the equations describing how fluids such as water and air move. The open question is whether their solutions always stay smooth and well behaved.
An American company that builds AI systems, including ChatGPT. Here it claims its internal model solved major maths problems.
Another American AI company, the maker of the Claude assistant.
Claude is the AI model made by Anthropic.
The most prestigious prize in mathematics, awarded every four years to outstanding mathematicians under 40. Often described as maths' version of a Nobel prize.
To conquer is to defeat an enemy by force. Here the writer uses it playfully for finally defeating a problem that had beaten everyone else.
When a problem falls, it is finally solved or defeated, as if it were a castle under siege. Here the problem fell to a machine rather than a human.
Here wrestling does not mean the sport. To wrestle with a problem is to struggle with it for a long time.
A torrent is a fast, powerful rush of water, and figuratively an overwhelming flood of something. Here it describes 719 papers released at once.
To detail something is to describe it fully, point by point.
Paralysed means unable to move, and figuratively so shocked or overwhelmed that you cannot act or think. It shows how stunned the mathematician is.
To endorse something is to publicly say you support it. Over 8,000 researchers have signed on to the statement.
Misalignment means things not lined up as they should be. In AI talk it means a system's goals or behaviour not matching what humans want or need.
Beyond marriage, divorced from means completely separated from. Solutions divorced from human understanding are answers with no human grasp of why they are true.
If something is left unchecked, nobody stops or controls it, so it may grow worse. It introduces a warning about what could happen.
To sterilise is to kill germs, but also to make something unable to produce anything new, like a barren field. Hairer fears AI would drain the life and creativity out of maths.
On its face means judging by first appearances. Looking only at the surface, the reaction seems strange, though the article then digs deeper.
A vested interest is a personal stake in how something turns out, usually because you benefit or lose. It hints that mathematicians may be protecting their jobs.
Special pleading means arguing that rules should not apply to your own case, an argument made out of self-interest. The writer says the mathematicians' case is more than that.
An uproar is a loud outburst of public anger or protest.
A quest is a long search for something difficult, as in old tales of knights. Here it means the long hunt for a solution.
To spur someone on is to push them forward, as a rider uses spurs on a horse. Hard problems drive people to invent new methods.
Numbers that give a negative result when multiplied by themselves, which seems impossible. Once dismissed as useless, they are now essential in electronics and physics.
To underpin is to support from underneath, like the foundations of a building. Imaginary numbers form the base of much modern technology.
Subtle means delicate and clever, hard to notice or grasp. Here the old quote jokes that imaginary numbers were all cleverness and no use.
To allege is to claim something is true without having proved it.
Frankenstein is the novel in which a scientist stitches together body parts to make a creature. Calling a paper a Frankenstein means it is a messy patchwork of parts that do not fit together neatly.
A frontier is the edge of what is settled or known. To push the frontier is to make a discovery beyond current knowledge.
A large language model: an AI trained on vast amounts of text, such as ChatGPT or Claude, that can write and answer questions.
Scientists who use maths and ideas, rather than lab experiments, to explain how the universe works.
A boon is a great benefit or blessing.
A citation is when one research paper mentions another as a source. More citations means more researchers found the work important.
Incremental means happening in small steps. Incremental research adds a little to what is known instead of making a giant leap.
Speculative means based on guesses and bold ideas rather than solid evidence. Such work is risky and may fail.
Profound means very deep and important, with far-reaching effects.
A loop closes when a process feeds back into itself with no outside help. Here AI would handle every step of the research cycle without a human.
A hypothesis is a proposed explanation that can be tested. Scientists form one, test it, then judge the result.
Autonomously means acting independently, without being controlled by others.
Archaeologists study the past by digging up what earlier people left behind. The comparison suggests scientists might puzzle over AI's finished work to see how it was made.
Ripe usually describes fruit ready to pick. Figuratively, it means ready for something to happen.
Jobless means without a job. The writer notes that mathematicians still have work.
Fruitful means productive, producing good results.
To do something at your peril is to do it while risking serious trouble. Underestimating AI could backfire on scientists, as it did on Alain Connes.
